status.description:
Wallet status:
When the wallet has just been registered, it receives the status `pending`.

At this point the user must accept the terms and start the homologation.

When clicking on "Proceed with Homologation", the status changes to `homologating`.

A boleto and a Homologation remittance will be generated to be sent to the bank. After completion, the status changes to `validating`.

From this point on, the user needs to inform the value of the boleto that was generated or send the return processed by the bank.

When the value is correctly informed, or in the processed return, the bank says everything is correct, the status changes to `active`.

* `pending` Homologation not started
* `homologating` In homologation, awaiting boleto payment
* `validating` Boleto paid, awaiting validation
* `active` Active and ready to use

default.description:
Default.
The `default` field determines the collection wallet that will be used in the creation of the boleto when no wallet is provided.

When the first wallet is homologated (moves to `status` = `active`), it receives the value `default` = `true`
